result.topic_en: Two indefinite integrals of an exponential multiplied by a cosine or a sine.
result.transcription:
$\int e^{-tx}\cos ax.\partial x = \frac{a\sin ax - t\cos ax}{tt+aa}.e^{-tx}$
$\int e^{-tx}\sin ax\,\partial x = \frac{-a\cos ax - t\sin ax}{tt+aa}.e^{-tx}$
